Name: JerryBB's Pelican Morning Walk
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[size=5][b]JerryBB's Pelican Morning Walk[/b][/size]
Version 1.0.0 (PC)

Pick the days you'd like to go for a walk, and some of Pelican Town's villagers will be waiting for you by the lamp west of Harvey's clinic. Walk or jog one of three courses together, listen to them chat along the way, and share a cold drink when you get back.

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]From year 1, Lewis and Alex invite you the first sunny morning you step out of your farmhouse.[/*]
[*]Press [b]J[/b] to open the walk menu and pick your walk days on the calendar. Rain, snow, festivals and weddings cancel the walk for that day.[/*]
[*]Meet at the lamp west of Harvey's clinic. The walk starts at 8:30 AM by default, and you can join from 30 minutes before.[/*]
[*]Choose a course: the Town loop, the Beach, or Robin's mountain path.[/*]
[*]Walk or jog with up to four villagers. Follow the markers on the ground and stay with the group.[/*]
[*]Come back to the lamp together to get a sports drink and a little friendship with everyone who walked with you.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Villagers actually walk the route on the map and go around objects and furniture placed in town.[/*]
[*]Nearby villagers chat with each other while walking, and say hello at the start and the finish.[/*]
[*]Talk to your spouse before the walk to bring them along. You can also go on a walk with just your spouse.[/*]
[*]With Stardew Valley Expanded installed, the courses follow the expanded town map.[/*]
[*]With Market Town installed, the group takes a detour around the market area so nobody walks through the stalls.[/*]
[*]Start time, walk length, number of villagers, route markers and chatter can be changed in Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later (PC)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.2 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the English or Korean version, unzip it, and put the "JerryBB's Pelican Morning Walk" folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Single player only. Multiplayer is not supported.[/*]
[*]Please back up your save before trying a new mod.[/*]
[*]If something goes wrong, upload your SMAPI log at [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url] and post the link in the Bugs tab.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b][color=#e06666]Translations and reuploads[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Do not translate, reupload, or redistribute this mod without my permission.[/b]
If you'd like to make a translation, please send me a message first. Unauthorized translations and reuploads will be reported to Nexus Mods and to the site they were posted on.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Thank you so much to these creators. This mod wouldn't exist without their work.
[list]
[*]ConcernedApe, for Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]Pathoschild, for SMAPI[/*]
[*]spacechase0, for Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[*]FlashShifter, for Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[/list]
[size=2][i]The main image and header banner were made with AI image tools. All other screenshots are taken from the actual game.[/i][/size]
